description: This file implements a Double Array trie data structure for sequences of strings, including functions for building, encoding, and prefix matching.

classes.name: DoubleArray
classes.description: A data structure for efficient prefix matching on sequences of strings.

classes.name: node
classes.description: A helper struct representing a node in the trie during construction.

methods.name: NewDoubleArray
methods.description: Constructs a DoubleArray from a set of string sequences.

methods.name: registerTokens
methods.description: Encodes tokens in sequences to integers and appends terminators.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the integer value of a token at a specific position in sequences.

methods.name: children
methods.description: Generates child nodes for a given node based on sequence data.

methods.name: addSeqs
methods.description: Recursively adds sequences to the DoubleArray structure.

methods.name: ensureSize
methods.description: Ensures the internal arrays are large enough to accommodate a given index.

methods.name: HasCommonPrefix
methods.description: Checks if any sequence in the DoubleArray is a prefix of a given sequence.
